schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS investment_event (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')), source_date TEXT, date_basis TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, game TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS investment_event_user ON investment_event(user_id, id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS investment_event_source ON investment_event(user_id, source_kind, source_id, id)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS investment_card_insert_v1 AFTER INSERT ON collection WHEN NEW.user_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT NEW.user_id, 'card', NEW.id, 'insert', substr(NEW.added_at,1,10), 'added_at', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(NEW.purchase_price,0)*100) AS INTEGER)*COALESCE(NEW.quantity,1), 'USD', COALESCE(NEW.game,'pokemon'), CASE WHEN NEW.list_type='collection' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS investment_card_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE OF purchase_price, quantity, game, list_type, user_id, added_at ON collection WHEN OLD.purchase_price IS NOT NEW.purchase_price OR OLD.quantity IS NOT NEW.quantity OR OLD.game IS NOT NEW.game OR OLD.list_type IS NOT NEW.list_type OR OLD.user_id IS NOT NEW.user_id OR OLD.added_at IS NOT NEW.added_at BEGIN INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT OLD.user_id, 'card', OLD.id, 'reassigned', substr(OLD.added_at,1,10), 'added_at', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(OLD.purchase_price,0)*100) AS INTEGER)*COALESCE(OLD.quantity,1), 'USD', COALESCE(OLD.game,'pokemon'), 0 WHERE OLD.user_id IS NOT NEW.user_id AND OLD.user_id IS NOT NULL; INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT NEW.user_id, 'card', NEW.id, 'update', substr(NEW.added_at,1,10), 'added_at', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(NEW.purchase_price,0)*100) AS INTEGER)*COALESCE(NEW.quantity,1), 'USD', COALESCE(NEW.game,'pokemon'), CASE WHEN NEW.list_type='collection' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE NEW.user_id IS NOT NULL; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS investment_card_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON collection WHEN OLD.user_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT OLD.user_id, 'card', OLD.id, 'delete', substr(OLD.added_at,1,10), 'added_at', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(OLD.purchase_price,0)*100) AS INTEGER)*COALESCE(OLD.quantity,1), 'USD', COALESCE(OLD.game,'pokemon'), 0; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS investment_sealed_insert_v1 AFTER INSERT ON sealed_lot WHEN NEW.user_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT NEW.user_id, 'sealed', NEW.id, 'insert', NEW.purchased_at, 'purchased_at', NEW.total_cost_cents, NEW.currency, 'pokemon', CASE WHEN NEW.archived_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sealed_product p WHERE p.id=NEW.product_id AND p.user_id=NEW.user_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS investment_sealed_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE OF total_cost_cents, quantity, currency, purchased_at, archived_at, user_id, product_id ON sealed_lot WHEN OLD.total_cost_cents IS NOT NEW.total_cost_cents OR OLD.quantity IS NOT NEW.quantity OR OLD.currency IS NOT NEW.currency OR OLD.purchased_at IS NOT NEW.purchased_at OR OLD.archived_at IS NOT NEW.archived_at OR OLD.user_id IS NOT NEW.user_id OR OLD.product_id IS NOT NEW.product_id BEGIN INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT OLD.user_id, 'sealed', OLD.id, 'reassigned', OLD.purchased_at, 'purchased_at', OLD.total_cost_cents, OLD.currency, 'pokemon', 0 WHERE OLD.user_id IS NOT NEW.user_id AND OLD.user_id IS NOT NULL; INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT NEW.user_id, 'sealed', NEW.id, 'update', NEW.purchased_at, 'purchased_at', NEW.total_cost_cents, NEW.currency, 'pokemon', CASE WHEN NEW.archived_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sealed_product p WHERE p.id=NEW.product_id AND p.user_id=NEW.user_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE NEW.user_id IS NOT NULL; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS investment_sealed_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON sealed_lot WHEN OLD.user_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT OLD.user_id, 'sealed', OLD.id, 'delete', OLD.purchased_at, 'purchased_at', OLD.total_cost_cents, OLD.currency, 'pokemon', 0; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS investment_product_visibility_v1 AFTER UPDATE OF archived_at, user_id ON sealed_product WHEN OLD.archived_at IS NOT NEW.archived_at OR OLD.user_id IS NOT NEW.user_id BEGIN INSERT INTO investment_event (user_id, source_kind, source_id, operation, source_date, date_basis, amount_cents, currency, game, active) SELECT l.user_id, 'sealed', l.id, 'product-visibility', l.purchased_at, 'purchased_at', l.total_cost_cents, l.currency, 'pokemon', CASE WHEN l.archived_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sealed_product p WHERE p.id=l.product_id AND p.user_id=l.user_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM sealed_lot l WHERE l.product_id=NEW.id AND l.user_id IS NOT NULL; END

dailySchema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolio_daily_performance (user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, game TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, time_zone TEXT NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL, value_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, cards_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, sealed_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, invested_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, gain_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, return_pct REAL, ledger_id INTEGER NOT NULL, stale_rates INTEGER NOT NULL, unpriced_cards INTEGER NOT NULL, unpriced_sealed INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id,game,currency,time_zone,day))
dailyUpsert: INSERT INTO portfolio_daily_performance (user_id,game,currency,time_zone,day,recorded_at,value_cents,cards_cents,sealed_cents,invested_cents,gain_cents,return_pct,ledger_id,stale_rates,unpriced_cards,unpriced_sealed) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(user_id,game,currency,time_zone,day) DO UPDATE SET recorded_at=excluded.recorded_at,value_cents=excluded.value_cents,cards_cents=excluded.cards_cents,sealed_cents=excluded.sealed_cents,invested_cents=excluded.invested_cents,gain_cents=excluded.gain_cents,return_pct=excluded.return_pct,ledger_id=excluded.ledger_id,stale_rates=excluded.stale_rates,unpriced_cards=excluded.unpriced_cards,unpriced_sealed=excluded.unpriced_sealed WHERE excluded.recorded_at>=portfolio_daily_performance.recorded_at
